findings.location: ## Statement, sentence concluding global minimization and normal-cone membership: the references to the feasible set C and N_C(x_*)
findings.evidence: The theorem states the objective, inequalities, and equalities Ax=b, then uses C in both conclusions without defining C or explicitly instantiating the generic program definition with h(x)=Ax-b. Define C={x in U: Ax=b, g_i(x)<=0} and specify the finite inequality index range so both conclusions have a bound subject.

findings.location: ## Proof, step 1.2: the assertion that R_J is continuous and the resulting closed-preimage claim
findings.evidence: The proof uses continuity of R_J(y)=G_J^{-1}A_J^T y to conclude R_J^{-1}(R_{>=0}^{|J|}) is closed, but neither proves continuity nor cites a dependency that supplies it. Add an estimate such as ||R_J(y)-R_J(y')||_2 <= ||G_J^{-1}A_J^T||_2 ||y-y'||_2, or cite a result establishing continuity of finite-dimensional matrix maps.
